title: Anomaly quenching and dynamical cooling of Hawking evaporation in Horndeski gravity
summary: We investigate the semiclassical Hawking evaporation of a two-dimensional Callan-Giddings-Harvey-Strominger (CGHS) black hole perturbed by first-order Horndeski scalar-tensor couplings. By evaluating the exact scalar curvature invariants, we demonstrate that coordinate singularities near the apparent horizon parametrize a physical deformation of the surface gravity while preserving a strictly regular event horizon.
